sources.snippet: These GGUF files are quantized using APEX, a novel MoE-aware mixed-precision quantization technique that outperforms standard quantization methods while being significantly smaller. APEX beats Q8_0 perplexity at half the size — and even beats F16. sources.snippet: A production-stable deployment of AEON-7/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-heretic-NVFP4 with DFlash speculative decoding on NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10 / sm_121a). ⚠️ READ THE REQUIREMENTS SECTION FIRST. This image and its weights are tuned specifically for the DGX Spark (GB10 / sm_120-121 Blackwell). It will NOT work on Hopper, Ampere, B200, or other Blackwell variants without rebuilding.
